title: Joachim Abbas
html_source:
A reference to Joachim of Fiore.

12th century wanderer and Cistercian who set up his own monastery and prophesised a time based an ‘eternal gospel’. Was later condemned by the papacy.

Books detailing the ideas of Joacchim of Fiore were in Marsh’s Library.
